sections.title: Inputs And Marking Model
sections.text: marks required nonempty array of marking descriptors. Each mark has id (string), kind (text|symbol|arrow), representation (annotation|emboss|engrave), position ([x,y,z] length expressions), and dimensions ({height, width?, stroke?}). text/symbol marks require nonempty content, which is preserved verbatim and never translated. arrow marks require a flow direction [nx,ny,nz] and take no content. emboss/engrave may declare depth and font; annotation is a pure descriptor. source is an optional {item?, level?, flow?, path?, status?} with status CONFIRMED/ESTIMATED/OPEN. reference ({kind: 'liquid-level', bound: min|max}) and levelValue link a marking to the computed liquid level. zones/keepouts are optional region descriptors. schemaVersion required 1.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'marking.create',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,marks:[{id,kind,representation,content,position,occupancy:{min,max,size,units},direction,depth,font,source,nativeAcceptance,annotation,geometryRecipe,feasible,warnings,zoneViolations,keepoutViolations}],annotationCount,geometryRecipeCount,warningCount,violationCount,violations,nativeAcceptance}. status is fail when any mark lands in a protected zone or a keepout, pass otherwise. Native emboss/engrave is gated (notEvaluated), never replaced by an image.

examples.label: Preserved Text Annotation
examples.requires: Open Design document; one text annotation with explicit font and source.
examples.output: result.marks[0].content is exactly 'MAX', result.marks[0].nativeAcceptance is 'annotation', and result.status is 'pass'.

bugs: Native emboss/engrave authoring is gated (notEvaluated); no Fusion SketchTexts/Extrude call is made.

sections.title: Inputs And Checks
sections.text: marks required nonempty array (as marking.create). levels optional {min, max, source?} computed liquid level; a mark with reference {kind:'liquid-level', bound:min|max} is verified so that its declared levelValue matches levels[bound] within tolerance. flows optional array of {id?, direction} for arrow direction matching. zones/keepouts optional; optical/seal/a-surface zones are protected. tolerance default '0 mm'. schemaVersion required 1.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'marking.check',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,marks:[{id,kind,checks,occupancy,passed}],violations,violationCount,unevaluable,levels,flows}. status is fail when any violation exists, unknown when a check could not be evaluated (missing levels/flows), pass otherwise. A geometry mark with resolvedRepresentation 'image' is a substitution violation.

examples.label: MAX Derived From Computed Level
examples.requires: Open Design document; one MAX marking whose levelValue equals the computed max level.
examples.output: result.status is 'pass' and result.marks[0].checks contains a level-derivation check with passed true.

bugs: Zone containment is axis-aligned occupancy, not native glyph outline intersection.
